descripcion: CAMBRIDGE STREET, 12. La lavandera. Entrega TRES muertes de una sola casa, que es lo que hacia el colera en 1854 y lo que ninguna puerta habia ensenado todavia: no se llevaba a uno de aqui y otro de alla, vaciaba viviendas enteras.
_por_que_tres: Tres muertes en una casa: el brote va por domicilios.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

abre.texto: You are the curate from St Luke's. Come in, but I have washing to finish.

opciones.texto: Has anyone in this house died?
I can come back another day.

no_hace_falta.texto: No, ask now. I will have less time tomorrow, not more.

opciones.texto: Has anyone in this house died?

los_tres.texto: My sister, Mary Ann Dover, died on Wednesday. Her husband Edward the same night. Their boy Thomas on Thursday morning.

el_nino.texto: Thomas was nine. Please give him his own line in the register.

opciones.texto: I will. Where did they get their water?

agua.texto: They drank from the Broad Street pump, like the rest of this street. I wash with it too.

adios.texto: Now let me finish my washing.

opciones.texto: Where did they get their water?

_pivote: Distractores: dos Thomas (Carr y Dover) y dos días seguidos.
